plan.purpose: Owner-run CLI deployment after the Meteor-blocked attempt is conclusively resolved; wallet protection stays enabled
plan.replaces_only: Infrastructure signing route/key-control proof from the original plan; the customer create_vault call remains under its original approval
conditions: Explicit approval of this signing route/key-proof amendment before signing
Do not sign or broadcast a replacement while the old attempt is unknown and potentially valid
If old attempt is FINAL success, verify existing factory and skip replacement entirely

Otherwise require conclusive FINAL failure with absent target, or finalized expiry with original hash unknown, unchanged old key nonce and absent target; a finalized nonce that already invalidates the old transaction can also resolve it after inspection
Do not send a nonce-bump or key-change transaction to force resolution under this plan
After resolution, refresh tested protocol, storage/fee schedule, signer key, balance and target absence; retain enough balance for the original customer call
Prepare one fresh exact unsigned transaction in a separate exclusive fsynced CLI outbox; preserve the original outbox
User runs official near-cli-rs 0.30.1 offline with existing secure-keychain key to save the signed transaction to a file; no key export
Cryptographically verify CLI signature against exact prepared bytes, key, nonce and hash before any broadcast
Persist the signed outbox, then submit exactly once and wait for FINAL; unknown outcomes block fresh retries
Verify finalized factory code hash, embedded vault hash, immutable configuration and absence of keys before the original customer call
excluded: Key export, key installation or key revocation
Changing contract code, funding amount, initializer or target
Payments, worker activation, checkpoints or unpause
